messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: mastar-manual, p. 32

7.2.3 Greasing the Slide Tracks Lubricate the raceways of the sliding blocks at least every 6 months. To do so, move the lifting carriage to the lowest position. Then loosen and remove the spindle cover on the head plate. Lightly grease all slider tracks over the entire length with a brush. 7.2.4 Greasing the Arm Extensions Check the support arms for free movement at least every 6 months and lightly oil the pull-out points and the roller support if necessary. 32 BA364501-en

Spindle cover on head plate | must be loosened and removed | before greasing slide tracks | | loosen and remove the spindle cover on the head plate
Slider tracks | must be lightly greased | over entire length with a brush | | Lightly grease all slider tracks over the entire length with a brush.
Support arms | must be checked for free movement | at least every 6 months | | Check the support arms for free movement at least every 6 months
Pull-out points and roller support | must be lightly oiled | if necessary | if necessary | lightly oil the pull-out points and the roller support if necessary
